You may use the following functions:

tokenize:
  (string) -> (array of string)

tokenize(s) returns an array of the tokens in s, in the order in which they appear.

chain_follow:
  (array of string) -> (array of string)

chain_follow(chain) returns the next pair in the chain, or the dangling end of the chain if the chain is complete.

chain_follow(chain)
  1. if chain is empty, return the dangling end
  2. if chain has only one pair, return the dangling end
  3. if the first pair in the chain is (A, B), return the pair whose first item is B
